name: afya_voice_data_agent
description: MongoDB MCP superpower layer. Handles encounter insertion, vector embedding storage, autonomous index management, alert CRUD, and offline queue sync.

tools.name: insert_encounter
tools.description: Insert a geo-enriched encounter into MongoDB with vector embedding. Demonstrates autonomous MongoDB document insertion.

tools.name: batch_insert_encounters
tools.description: Batch insert up to 50 encounters (offline sync). Generates embeddings for each.

tools.name: query_active_alerts
tools.description: Query active alerts from MongoDB, optionally filtered by county.

tools.name: update_alert_status
tools.description: Acknowledge an alert (sets status and records who acknowledged).

tools.name: resolve_alert
tools.description: Resolve an alert with resolution notes.

tools.name: create_vector_index
tools.description: Idempotent: creates the Atlas Vector Search index on encounters.embedding (768-dim cosine). Demonstrates autonomous vector index creation.

tools.name: sync_offline_encounters
tools.description: Process encounters queued while offline. Inserts in batches of 50.
